title: Learn Ancient Greek with Beginner Stories - Aesop's Fables - 1: Interlinear Ancient Greek
description: Learn Ancient Greek with Beginner Stories: Aesop’s Fables – Part 1 brings the timeless fables of Aesop to Ancient Greek learners through HypLern’s interlinear reading method. The book presents authentic Ancient Greek together with a direct English translation, allowing you to see the meaning and structure of the original language as you read. Instead of learning Ancient Greek only through grammar tables, vocabulary lists, and isolated exercises, this book helps you experience the language in context. Each line of Ancient Greek is followed by a word-for-word English rendering, making the original sentence structure immediately visible and reducing the need to stop and look up every unfamiliar form. The interlinear approach is designed to help you: Read real Ancient Greek from the beginning Recognize vocabulary in meaningful context See how Greek grammar and sentence structure actually work Build familiarity with common forms and patterns through repetition Develop the confidence to rely less and less on the English translation Aesop’s short fables are especially well suited to this method. Their compact stories, memorable characters, humor, and moral lessons make it possible to encounter a wide variety of Ancient Greek vocabulary and grammar without having to work through long passages at once. The book can be used on its own as reading practice or alongside a traditional Ancient Greek course. Structured study teaches the rules; interlinear reading reinforces those rules by letting you encounter them repeatedly in genuine sentences and stories. On a first reading, simply follow the story and use the English whenever necessary. On later readings, stay with the Ancient Greek for longer before checking the translation. title: Learn Ancient Egyptian Hieroglyphs - Series 1 - Alphabet
description: •Learn the Ancient Egyptian Hieroglyph Alphabet sound signs •Learn 124 Hieroglyph Vocabulary words •Learn 94 Hieroglyph Determinatives •A total of 375 Quiz questions with answers to test and reinforce your knowledge •Learn Pronunciation •Learn Transliteration •Learn the Hieratic Script ~~Learn Hieroglyphs - Series 1 - Alphabet is the first in a series of Ancient Egyptian Hieroglyphic Tutorials. title: Learn to Read Ancient Hebrew: An Introduction for Complete Beginners
description: Ancient Biblical Hebrew goes back nearly 3,000 years into the past, preserving myths, laws, and ritual traditions that date even earlier. But learning to read this ancient language usually requires years of formal training, or relying on books written with overly technical jargon. Reading the Hebrew Bible/Old Testament has therefore been restricted to the lucky few - until now! Learn to Read Ancient Hebrew: An Introduction for Complete Beginners, Volume One is written specifically for people with no training in ancient languages, allowing you to learn biblical Hebrew without having to struggle with grammatical jargon. Everything is explained in clear language, with a handy index providing definitions just in case you need a reminder. Each of the 10 chapters introduce and explain important grammatical features, building upon previous lessons to provide an in-depth understanding of the language without being overwhelming. Every chapter includes a list of the most commonly used Hebrew vocabulary, as well as exercises to help solidify your understanding of grammatical concepts. Because we teach you using the ancient Hebrew script, you start reading authentic ancient Hebrew right from the start, building up to translating entire stories by the end of only the first volume. As part of the Learn to Read Ancient Languages Series, this first of three volumes will have you reading biblical Hebrew before you know it! This book will: Teach you the fundamentals of ancient Hebrew grammar in language you can understand. Give you exercises so you can test and consolidate your new-found knowledge. title: Learn Ancient Greek with Beginner Stories - Aesop's Fables - 2: Interlinear Ancient Greek
description: Learn Ancient Greek with Beginner Stories: Aesop’s Fables – Part 2 continues HypLern’s interlinear journey through the witty, memorable world of Aesop. This second collection brings together another wide-ranging selection of Aesop’s fables in Ancient Greek, including famous stories such as The North Wind and the Sun and The Donkey in the Lion’s Skin , alongside many lesser-known tales of foxes, wolves, lions, birds, farmers, travelers, gods, and fools. Each passage presents the original Ancient Greek together with a direct interlinear English translation , allowing you to follow the vocabulary and sentence structure of the Greek itself instead of replacing it immediately with polished English. Where necessary, additional idiomatic translations clarify expressions that cannot be understood naturally from a purely word-for-word rendering. The result is a reading method that keeps you immersed in the original language while still giving you immediate access to its meaning. Rather than learning Ancient Greek only through grammar tables, isolated vocabulary, and exercises, you encounter the language repeatedly in complete sentences and memorable stories. You begin to see how Greek word order works, how case endings and verb forms contribute to meaning, and how familiar grammatical patterns recur naturally from one fable to the next. Aesop’s fables are especially suited to this approach. Their stories are short enough to read without becoming overwhelming, yet varied enough to expose you to a broad range of vocabulary, grammar, dialogue, narration, and proverbial expressions. title: Complete Ancient Greek: A Comprehensive Guide to Reading and Understanding Ancient Greek,

Featuring additional exercises in this new edition, this is a genuinely comprehensive yet accessible introduction to Ancient Greek. title: Learn to Read Ancient Sumerian: An Introduction for Complete Beginners.
description: Sumerian is the world's oldest written language, but the ability to read it is restricted to the lucky few - until now! Learn to Read Ancient Sumerian: An Introduction for Complete Beginners is written specifically for people with no training in ancient languages, letting the reader learn Sumerian without having to learn grammatical jargon first. Any grammatical terms that are used are explained in clear language, and a handy index provides definitions just in case you need a reminder! Each of the 11 chapters introduce and explain important grammatical features, building upon previous chapters to provide and in-depth understanding of the language without being overwhelming. Every chapter includes a list of vocabulary and cuneiform signs for the student to master, as well as exercises to help solidify the reader's understanding of grammatical concepts. Exercises written in cuneiform mean that you start reading authentic Sumerian right from the start, building up to translating ancient cuneiform inscriptions from drawings and photographs! This book will: Teach you the fundamentals of Sumerian grammar in language you can understand. Give you exercises so you can test and consolidate your new-found knowledge. Let you read actual cuneiform inscriptions from 4,000 years ago! Unfortunately, the first printed copies contained errors. title: Learn Ancient Egyptian Hieroglyphs - Series 3 - Triliterals (Learn Hieroglyphs)
description: This ebook is the third in a series of tutorials on Ancient Egyptian Hieroglyphs. The first volume covers the Ancient Egyptian Alphabet or Uniliterals, the second volume covers the Biliterals and this volume covers the Triliterals. What are hieroglyphic triliterals? They are a combination of three hieroglyphic phonetic alphabet signs. In this tutorial you will learn 40 triliterals. Included are 125 hieroglyphic signs; over 148 hieroglyphic vocabulary words and much more. This ebook is loaded with detailed graphics of the Ancient Egyptian Hieroglyphs; they are in color and look stunning when used on your Kindle for the iPhone or Kindle for the PC, or the Kindle app for the iPad. They appear in grey scale on the Kindle itself and are elegantly beautiful. Suggestion: use the Kindle zoom feature to enlarge each triliteral page! • 1. The Triliterals - Each Triliteral is listed individually on its own page and numbered 1 to 40. Each Triliteral includes 1 to 3 vocabulary words showing it's use and a simplified breakdown of the hieroglyphs used to make up the words • 4.
